For every $t_0<T$, $(\Ar ^3,g(t_0))$ is complete and has positive curvature.
Proof

↗ prop:forward-difference-maximum ↗ lem:curvature-evolution-frame ↗ nullspace \sketch Bounded curvature on $[0,t_0]$ gives $g(0)\le Cg(t_0)$, hence completeness. A proper barrier $\varphi $ with $(\partial _t-\triangle )\varphi \ge C\varphi $ applies the tensor maximum principle to $\mathcal T+\varphi g$, proving nonnegative curvature; the nullspace principle gives strict positivity for $t_0>0$.

□

Proposition
[Asymptotic convergence to the standard evolving cylinder]
